_note: Discovery is the best fit for the free lane in the whole system: a new
harvest route has an unambiguous oracle — run it, and see whether a
verified-downloadable op comes out. Success is cheap to check, so an
agent can write production code with no review at all.

red.reason: database ingest handoff; appending ops via queue_op is harvest output, editing ingest is not
infrastructure and job/env deploy configs; changes take effect only through a rebuild and a deploy, so they wait for the operator
the verifier decides whether a route counts as working; the agent it grades does not get to loosen it

the instructions of the agents that review other agents, and the operator's scale direction; an agent that can rewrite the reviewer above it is not supervised, so these reach the operator even when a master writes them
campaign definitions are the operator's portfolio; agents grow harvest capacity around a campaign, they do not create or rewrite the campaign itself

zones.serves: SCALE — freestyle interaction log and bake handoff artefacts
zones.oracle: python -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('.'); hits=list(p.glob('state/*/rd_retro_handoff/interaction.jsonl')); sys.exit(0 if hits else 1)"
zones.note: Freestyle's product is the interaction handoff, not harvester code. Bake reads this; freestyle writes it.

zones.serves: SCALE — output volume; new routes bake into production and are live next run
zones.note: The highest-value free lane in the system. Freestyle does not green here — bake does after a proven interaction log.

zones.serves: SCALE — operational artefacts a harvest session produces
zones.note: Queue rows, session state, harvester seen-files, and proposal JSON are normal session output — not control-plane.

zones.serves: SCALE — queue_op / queue_store used by freestyle (run + rare helper fixes)
zones.note: Freestyle primarily runs these scripts. Small helper fixes are green; ingest stays RED.

zones.serves: SCALE — coverage breadth (yaml only; json campaign files are operator RED)
zones.note: Campaign JSON is categorical RED (R8). Agents attach harvesters to a campaign from the harvest layer; they do not rewrite the portfolio.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — how readings are captured; former categorical red for masters
zones.note: PIT agents still score 100 for leaving their plate onto these files. Masters and retros may land a fix here; touching them still adds a caution score so a large instrument rewrite plus other smells can still trip RED.
A master that adds an investigating agent wires up what wakes it in the same change; an agent nothing triggers never runs.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — who investigates this subsystem, and what they are asked
zones.note: The sharpest surface in the system. A master retunes the agents that investigate this subsystem and may add one; it never edits the file that defines itself (deny_self), and the supervisor definitions are RED above.
